item.title: SEO, AEO and GEO: the difference and where to start
item.description: SEO gets your page to show up in search. AEO gets your content chosen as the direct answer. GEO gets generative AI to cite your brand. All three start from the same base, a fast, crawlable site with clear answers. Start there.
